verdict.rationale: Auth0's own materials say enterprise clients can "synchronize user directories via SCIM or Google Workspace," and the pricing page lists SCIM as a new Enterprise Connection feature, so the core SCIM provisioning capability is first-party. The evidence is marketing-level only and never mentions group sync or deprovisioning. missing for 10: evidence of group/membership sync via SCIM, documentation that IdP deprovisioning deactivates users and revokes sessions/app access, in-depth SCIM docs (endpoints, attribute mapping), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
